notes.title: Bay Lynx is LIVE on Kickstarter
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Bay Lynx is now on Kickstarter!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cascadiagames/bay-lynx-platforming-purrfection][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1408850/extras/itch_kickstarter.png?t=1687578582[/img][/url]

We're looking to raise funds to add as much content as possible plus an extra layer of polish to the game during development. We've got some ground to cover to catch up to Super Mario Bros Wonder and Sega Superstars, so any support helps.

There's also an [url=https://cascadiagames.itch.io/bay-lynx-demo]alpha build demo [/url]associated with the campaign. Eventually, a more complete demo will appear on Steam as well. You can [url=https://cascadiagames.itch.io/bay-lynx-demo]download that here[/url].
